---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for own-harness
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Problem

What is the problem or limitation you are trying to solve? Describe the
scenario and why existing commands or policy features do not cover it.

## Proposed solution

Describe the behavior you would like, including the `harness` command or
`harness.config.yaml` surface if applicable.

## Alternatives

What alternatives have you considered (configuration, scripts, workarounds)?

## Impact

- Who benefits from this feature and how?
- Does it affect the security or privacy model (loopback-only proxy, secret
  handling, encryption, telemetry, policy distribution)?
- Does it require new dependencies, packages, or CI changes?

## Additional context

Any notes on implementation, related issues, or documentation to read
(`docs/` covers the architecture, policy DSL, and data model).
